methodologyNotes: Covers foldable/portable photovoltaic solar panels (briefcase, blanket, and folding-suitcase style) marketed for charging portable power stations or devices, sold at a published US price. Excludes rigid roof/RV-mounted panels, flexible marine panels sold by the pallet, and solar panels built into a power station. Price is typical US retail (MSRP) in USD. ratedPowerWatts is rated peak output at STC in watts. cellEfficiencyPct is the manufacturer-stated solar cell conversion efficiency in percent (null if not disclosed). cellType is a cell-chemistry enum: monocrystalline, polycrystalline, or thin-film. openCircuitVoltageV is open-circuit voltage (Voc) in volts. shortCircuitCurrentA is short-circuit current (Isc) in amps. weightLbs is panel weight in pounds, panel only (excluding cables), per the spec sheet. foldedDimsIn is folded/packed dimensions as length x width x thickness in inches. ingressProtection is the IP water/dust rating (e.g. IP65, IP67, IP68); null if not rated. surfaceMaterial is the laminate surface enum: ETFE, PET, tempered-glass, or PDMS. usbPortsBuiltIn is a boolean, true if the panel has onboard USB output ports for direct device charging. connectorOutput is the primary DC output connector enum: MC4, XT60, Anderson-APP, DC8020, DC7909, or proprietary.

products.provenance: The official Jackery product page (source) lists the SolarSaga 100W's full STC tech-spec table verbatim: Peak Power 100W±5W, Open Circuit Voltage 24.8V±5%, Short Circuit Current 5.4A±5%, Weight 7.94 lbs, IP68 waterproof, folded 24.0 x 21.7 x 1.4 in, premium monocrystalline cells at 25% conversion, and built-in USB-A (5V/2.4A) + USB-C (5V/3A) ports, with a regular list price of $299.00 ($199.00 on sale at access).
